private_content_policy: Raw message bodies and retrieved attachment bytes remain private under .mat-local; public receipt contains locators, hashes and scoped reconciliation only.

automation.completion_rule: Existing acceptance gates, scientific source review and independently evidenced outputs; unresolved data is not relabelled to obtain completion.

inventory.scope: Pinned and recent entries returned by one list_threads(limit50); not all account or archived chats.

findings.summary: The universal coverage and authored-framework instructions already have SRC-000342, SRC-000344 and SRC-000345 owners. Preserve Foundation 0000, Hydrogen 0001 and separate proposed identities; no duplicated requirement or replacement element.

Ground configurations, states and evaluated ionisation data already exist across the confirmed catalogue. General excited-state spectra and sonification remain separate work; the chat statement that NIST integration was not started is stale.

Lexical comparisons are preserved. A physical frequency operation needs phenomenon, subject/state, units, method, source locator and applicable model; harmonics or numerical similarity cannot establish mechanism or therapeutic effects.

Existing Russell/Rife preservation and claim lanes must be reused. Hero, Tainio, Bendall and Cousto leads require original sources; no numeric frequencies or medical effect is accepted from chat summaries.

Harmonograph, cymatics and Vitruvian/Giza reconstructions are source/model leads. Two available overlays are reference images; missing originals, fitted parameters, null tests and unavailable workbook prevent reproduction. No universal matching percentage or encoded historical intent is accepted.

The claimed image package and sandbox artifacts were not found in the canonical checkout. Explicitly truncated messages and attachment references require fuller retrieval; cursor end does not prove complete conversation/account coverage.
Patent archaeology is already required by original sections 076,077 and079. Candidate refrigeration and other patent cases refine those tasks rather than create a competing research backlog.

Retain experiment parents, versions, configuration, observations, failed branches and successor analyses. Existing claim and supersession contracts cover part of this; a general experiment lineage implementation is not established by the handover.

The engineering handoff reports a density/mass dependency without an accepted material/state/density source and uncertainty. The existing source-bound steel composition does not qualify bulk density or CAD mass properties. External engineering statuses are historical assertions.

Genesis compression/orchestration, Bridge execution, CAD installation and hardware experiments remain owned by those projects. Preserve MAT-relevant contracts and provenance without importing executable prompts or treating installations as scientific validation.

Cronin chemistry and molecular/biological research are already compiled in SRC-000344. Direct publications, source extraction, genomic assembly versions and failed/inconclusive experiments remain source-specific reviews; podcast interpretations are not verified measurements.

Holmium, element115, copper/EMF, MHD and magnetism/gravity chats supply attributed research leads only. Proposed layouts and assistant numbers are not measurements, thrust demonstrations or accepted energy sources; applicable primary evidence and conservation review are required.

Older addenda and build claims retain project ownership and historical dates. More cursor pages are available; benchmark/test assertions and external artifact completion require direct inspection before applying to MAT.
